Prepare calculations, single-line diagrams, load flow and short-circuit studies, protective device coordination, arc flash analysis, and grounding designs to meet NEC, IEEE, and local code requirements. Lead quality assurance and quality control activities, design reviews, and mentor junior engineers and designers. Knowledge of NEC, IEEE, UL standards, local codes, utility interconnection requirements, and permitting processes.
